title: Balloons
tagline: Free clipped balloons so they lift a box to hang inside a target band
description: Free clipped balloons so their combined lift raises a box to hang at rest inside a target band, without letting any balloon burst on the ceiling. Each colour's lift and each box's mass are hidden, and test levels need balloon combinations never tried in training.
solve_note: A scripted plan: two balloons are freed in an order that keeps both below the ceiling, and the box settles inside the band.
init_note: Starting layouts of up to four training and eight test tasks; repeated layouts are shown once.

title: Boil
tagline: Fill jugs at a faucet and boil them on a burner without spilling
description: Fill each jug under the faucet and boil it on the burner without spilling, then turn the burner off. Training has one jug; the test level has two jugs sharing one burner.
solve_note: Planned with ground-truth process models (oracle process planning): both jugs are filled and boiled in turn on the one burner. Played at 2x speed.
init_note: Starting layouts of up to four training and eight test tasks; repeated layouts are shown once.

title: Bridge
tagline: Glue identical blocks into an n-shaped bridge whose joints cure over time
description: Stand two blocks as legs and glue the rest end to end into a span across them; glued joints weld only after a hidden curing time. Training builds a three-block span, the test level a four-block span.
solve_note: Planned with ground-truth process models (oracle process planning): two legs, a glued four-block span, and the span seated across the legs. Played at 5x speed.
init_note: Starting layouts of up to four training and eight test tasks; repeated layouts are shown once.

title: Domino
tagline: Place as few dominoes as possible so a pushed chain topples the target
description: Place as few blue dominoes as possible so that pushing the start domino topples the target. The true friction differs from the robot's belief, and the test level adds a 90-degree turn.
solve_note: A scripted Pick, Place and Push plan using two blue dominoes, computed with the true friction. Shown from a side camera so the cascade is visible.
init_note: Starting layouts of up to four training and eight test tasks; repeated layouts are shown once.

title: Fan
tagline: Switch banks of fans to blow a ball through a walled grid to a target
description: Switch banks of fans on and off to blow a ball around walls onto the target cell. Training uses a small open grid; the test level is a 10x9 maze.
solve_note: A scripted plan found by searching the maze: six runs of switching one fan bank on, waiting and switching it off, with the last wait timed to stop the ball on the target. Played at 3.5x speed.
init_note: Starting layouts of up to four training and eight test tasks; repeated layouts are shown once.

title: Busyboard
tagline: Light the right lamps on a board of switches with hidden wiring
description: Press switches in the right order to light a requested pattern of lamps. The wiring is hidden, lamps light only after a delay, and driving too many at once trips a breaker.
solve_note: Planned with ground-truth process models (oracle process planning): four switch presses, then a wait while the lamps charge. Played at half speed.
init_note: Every board starts with all switches off; training boards have 4 switches and test boards 7 or 8.

title: Crane
tagline: Swing a hinged ram to knock a crate onto a landing pad
description: Draw back a hinged ram and release it so it knocks a crate onto a landing pad. How far the crate slides depends on its hidden, material-dependent mass and friction.
solve_note: Planned with ground-truth process models: one pull of the ram, released at the planned depth. Slowed down 2.5x.
init_note: Starting layouts of up to four training and eight test tasks; repeated layouts are shown once.

title: Ice Rink
tagline: Push sliding tiles onto matching targets across a low-friction rink
description: Push coloured tiles across an ice rink so each comes to rest on its matching target. Each colour slides with its own hidden friction, and a dark strip brakes tiles that cross it.
solve_note: Planned with ground-truth process models: two pushes slide the tiles onto their targets. Slowed down 2.5x.
init_note: Starting layouts of up to four training and eight test tasks; repeated layouts are shown once.

title: Launcher
tagline: Cock a spring launcher to knock only the top block off a tower
description: Cock a spring launcher so its ball knocks only the red top block off a tower. Launch speed depends on how far the plunger is compressed, and balls are limited.
solve_note: Planned with ground-truth process models: one cock of the plunger knocks the top block off. Slowed down 3x.
init_note: Starting layouts of up to four training and eight test tasks; repeated layouts are shown once.

title: Magnets
tagline: Steer coloured pieces into slots with a magnetic wand
description: Steer coloured pieces into their slots by sliding a magnetic wand over the mat. Each colour has a hidden range and polarity, so some pieces follow the wand and one is pushed away.
solve_note: Planned with ground-truth process models: the wand drags two pieces into their slots. Played at half speed.
init_note: Starting layouts of up to four training and eight test tasks; repeated layouts are shown once.

title: Ants
tagline: Sort food by whether it attracts ants, stacking same-coloured items
description: Sort food by whether it attracts ants, and stack food of the same colour. Which colours attract ants must be inferred from where the ants walk.
solve_note: A scripted sequence of the environment's Pick, PutOnTable and Stack skills, computed from the task's goal.
init_note: Starting layouts of up to four training and eight test tasks; repeated layouts are shown once.

title: Balance
tagline: Equalise two plates on a beam, then press the button
description: Move blocks between two plates on a balance beam until they carry equal loads, then press the button. The button only works when the plates are balanced.
solve_note: A scripted sequence of the environment's skills: two blocks are stacked onto the lighter plate, then the button is pressed.
init_note: Starting layouts of up to four training and eight test tasks; repeated layouts are shown once.

title: Barrier
tagline: Raise and lower barriers with the switches that control them
description: Toggle two switches to raise or lower the barriers they control. Each barrier moves gradually after its switch changes.
solve_note: A scripted sequence of generic push skills toggles each switch whose barrier must change.
init_note: The layout is fixed; tasks differ in which switches start on.

title: Blocks
tagline: Rearrange blocks into the requested towers
description: Unstack and restack coloured blocks into the requested towers.
solve_note: Planned with ground-truth operators and samplers (bilevel planning): 14 skills rebuild two towers.
init_note: Starting layouts of up to four training and eight test tasks; repeated layouts are shown once.

title: Circuit
tagline: Wire a battery to a bulb and switch it on
description: Place two wire connectors between a battery and a bulb and switch the battery on.
solve_note: Planned with ground-truth operators and samplers (bilevel planning). Played at half speed.
init_note: Starting layouts of up to four training and eight test tasks; repeated layouts are shown once.

title: Coffee
tagline: Brew a jug of coffee and pour it into every cup
description: Brew a jug of coffee in the machine and pour it into every cup. The jug fills only while it sits in the running machine.
solve_note: Planned with ground-truth process models (oracle process planning).
init_note: Starting layouts of up to four training and eight test tasks; repeated layouts are shown once.

title: Cover
tagline: Place blocks so they cover target regions
description: Pick and place blocks so that they fully cover the target regions on the table.
solve_note: Planned with ground-truth operators and samplers (bilevel planning). Slowed down 2.5x.
init_note: Starting layouts of up to four training and eight test tasks; repeated layouts are shown once.

title: Float
tagline: Raise the water level to lift a floating block within reach
description: Drop heavy blocks into a pair of connected water tanks to raise the water, then grab the light block floating on top.
solve_note: Planned with ground-truth operators and samplers (bilevel planning). Played at half speed.
init_note: Starting layouts of up to four training and eight test tasks; repeated layouts are shown once.

title: Grow
tagline: Grow plants by pouring from the jug of matching colour
description: Pour from jugs onto plants in cups until every plant is grown. A plant grows only when the jug's colour matches its cup.
solve_note: Planned with ground-truth process models (oracle process planning).
init_note: Starting layouts of up to four training and eight test tasks; repeated layouts are shown once.

title: Laser
tagline: Place mirrors to route a laser beam onto the targets
description: Place mirrors to route a laser beam onto the targets, then switch the laser on. A split mirror both reflects and passes the beam.
solve_note: A scripted sequence of the environment's skills: the split mirror is moved into the beam, a mirror is turned, and the laser is switched on. The beam is drawn thicker for visibility.
init_note: Training and test tasks each use one fixed layout; the test layout adds a second target.

title: Magic Bin
tagline: Make blocks vanish by dropping them in a bin that a switch activates
description: Drop the named blocks into a bin and turn on its switch to make them vanish.
solve_note: A scripted sequence of generic push, pick and place skills: the switch is turned on, then each named block is dropped into the bin.
init_note: The layout is the same in every task; only which blocks must vanish changes.

title: Switch
tagline: Set a light's colour with a power switch and a colour switch
description: Use a power switch and a colour switch to make a light show the requested colour. Each off-to-on flick of the colour switch advances the colour.
solve_note: A scripted sequence of generic push skills: the colour switch is flicked until the right colour comes up, then the power switch is turned on.
init_note: The layout is the same in every task; only the starting and requested colours change.
